ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days, return to Company all Company data, Works and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data, Works and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard exit provision: on termination we can purchase up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, and our data, Works and Confidential Information are returned within 30 days in a machine-readable format and then deleted with written certification. The Agreement is currently silent on data return and wind-down, which leaves us without access to our own records; we can accept 90 days of transition assistance as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation in Section 6
